entities.summary: Club Brugge Koninklijke Voetbalvereniging, known simply as Club Brugge, is a Belgian professional football club based in Bruges, Belgium. It was founded in 1891 and its home ground is the Jan Breydel Stadium, which has a capacity of 29,042. They play in the Belgian Pro League, the top domestic league in Belgian football. Bart Verhaeghe was a performers & entertainers from Grimbergen (b. 1965, Grimbergen). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
